title: How many teeth
text: Through the point of connection with the blue gear, the pink gear moves over all $$14$$ teeth through a single rotation.

title: How many teeth
text: How many teeth of the blue gear pass through the connection point in $$1$$ rotation of the pink gear?

subHints.title: How many teeth
subHints.text: The blue gear is connected to the pink gear. As pink gear rotates once and moves through $$14$$ teeth. The blue gear will also rotate through $$14$$ teeth at the connection point.

title: How much did it rotate?
text: And $$14$$ teeth out of $$42$$ teeth is $$\frac{14}{42}=\frac{1}{3}$$ of a rotation.
